title: Redis: Internals & Practice
prereqs: Docker (challenges spin up a local Redis)
description: Redis under the hood and in practice: the single-threaded event loop, data-structure encodings (listpack/ziplist/hashtable/skiplist/intset), RDB vs AOF persistence, memory management & eviction policies, key expiration, replication & Sentinel, Cluster & hash slots, pub/sub & Streams, transactions (MULTI/WATCH) & Lua scripting, pipelining — each paired with hands-on patterns (caching, rate limiting, distributed locks, leaderboards, queues) against a local Redis.
